answer: One desk can mint many voting keys if title is reusable. Admission sells title to one harvest row in an orchard and one bay on a bonded wharf, carrying only one live key. The key delivers two saffron assays 167 minutes apart, each taken by a disjoint clerk after a 19-minute check, then posts assay_i = ripemd160(row||bay||clerk_pk||height||i). Title locks 25 POA for 6 epochs; each assay costs 0.36 POA. Auditors recheck title, occupancy, clerk disjointness, and spacing. A shared row or bay, a recycled clerk, or a pre-posted assay hash cuts 35 percent to that clerk and benches the key 7 epochs.
